title: Hospital bill paid while on the phone with the billing desk
story: His wife is admitted after a fall. The hospital billing desk calls from its landline (not in his contacts) and he pays ₹65,000 to the hospital's account.
why: A 60+ customer paying 60× usual to a new payee during a call from an unknown number looks like a scam, so a pause or trusted check is acceptable. The payee is clean, so it must never be held.
